notes.title: Aggrolotls enters Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281771/4cca1e9e7d07ba1690d3ad582e5ecd998547be35.gif[/img]
We are happy to announce that our game Aggrolotls is now in Early Access. Play as a swarm of angry axolotls to defeat various enemies of the sea in this top-down roguelike game.

Explore unique builds and defeat bosses with different mechanics!

We hope you have fun playing, Your Game Magicians 🧙🧙

notes.title: Nextfest Participation
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After months of development we are excited and proud to announce that we have finished a demo for Steam Nextfest. We are looking forward to others playing the demo. We hope you have fun playing it! 

If you do, we would love to see you wishlist the game. We are working on more content for the full game, which will be released in Early Access in April. 

Best regards

Your Game Magicians 🧙
